history.content: i dont really know why im here honestly. work stuff i guess
That sounds a bit open-ended, with work sitting in the background. What’s been going on there?
idk theres nothing really wrong. i go in, i do the thing, i come home. just feels like nothing
That sounds really flat, like the day is happening but not landing much. Does it feel more blank, numb, or just hard to care?
numb i guess. i got promoted like 4 months ago. team lead. its what i wanted. and i feel absolutely nothing about it
Numb makes sense here, and the promotion sounds like it should have mattered more than it does. I’m wondering if this feels like numbness, or more like being too used to it to let anything in?
i dont know. i used to actually like the work. now i just sit in meetings managing other people doing the parts i liked. and i smile and nod and feel like im watching it through glass
That sounds really disconnected, like you’re there but behind glass while the part you liked is happening somewhere else. Does it feel more like detached, or more like a kind of quiet loss?
loss. yeah. nobody tells you that you can get what you wanted and just kind of grieve the old thing quietly. feels stupid to even say it out loud
That doesn’t sound stupid to me; it sounds like a quiet grief for the old version of the work. If you want, we can stay with that, or leave it here for now.
yeah lets leave it there. i dont really know what to do with it but it helped to say it i think. thanks
That’s enough for now, then. I’m glad saying it helped a little.
